source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: F2b: gauge and radar states, the markers of a blurred series, a click on a large element, labels hidden at rest, the pictorial bar's hit target. A case sets `option` at T0 and settles; then at each sample t of samplesMs: the events at t (move: handler.mousemove at x,y; click: mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click at x,y; out: mousemove at 3,3; action: dispatchAction), then NOW = T1 + t and one zr.animation.update(), then the record. Element keys as advchart-state-anim.json; map: the port's part {s, row (inner index, -1 for a marker), part}. published: the chart's events per sample; selection: per sample (once when it never changes) every series' selectedMap and selected indices.

clock.note: each case on a clock of its own, later than every earlier one (the generation runs twice): only times relative to its t0, where the option is set and the settle starts, are written; T1 = t0 + T1Offset

cases.note: hover the pointer at 0: its fill lifts (z2EmphasisLift 0: no z2 change), the progress arc is another dispatcher and stays; out at 500
hover the progress arc at 0: it lifts alone, the pointer stays; out at 500
highlight dataIndex 0 at 0: the item graphic element is the pointer, the arc does not change; downplay at 500
two items, emphasis.focus self, titles and readings shown: hovering the second pointer blurs every other pointer and arc of the series (the texts have no states); out at 500
selectedMode single and a select colour: a click on the pointer selects (z2 + 9), a click on the arc dispatches select again (the arc is never flagged selected), a click on the pointer unselects
pointer.show false: highlight finds no item graphic element (nothing changes); the arc is still hovered at 400; out at 800
emphasis.itemStyle colour and border on both: hover the pointer, then the arc
hover a symbol of the first item at 0: the whole item group enters emphasis -- the polyline's stroke lifts, the symbols' fill (white, an emptyCircle) lifts, every z2 + 10; out at 500
hover the second item's polyline at 0; out at 500
areaStyle {}: the polygon shows (opacity 0.7); hover it at 0 (its fill lifts); out at 500
emphasis.focus self: hovering the first item blurs the second, whole; out at 500
highlight dataIndex 1 at 0, downplay at 500
selectedMode single, select.lineStyle colour and width: a click on a symbol selects the item (z2 + 9), a second click unselects
no areaStyle but emphasis.areaStyle: the polygon is ignored at rest and shows in emphasis
two radar series, the second with focus series: hovering it blurs the first (one radar coordinate system)
hover the second series (focus series) at 0: the first is blurred and its markPoint, markLine (line, end symbols, label) and markArea fade with it; out at 500
focus self on the first series: hovering its bar blurs the series itself, its markers too, and the second series (one grid); out at 500
highlight the second series' item 2 by action at 0 (focus series): the first and its markers blur; downplay at 500
a declared blur opacity on the markPoint (0.5) and the markLine (0.4); the markArea has emphasis disabled (no state proxy: its blur state is empty and changes nothing)
450 large bars, selectedMode single: a click on bar 100 dispatches select (the path is never flagged selected: a second click selects again); no state changes on the large path
no selectedMode: the click still dispatches select, selectchanged has nothing
a large scatter (threshold 20), selectedMode multiple: clicks on points 5 and 9

a large bar series under two scatters: highlighting scatter 1 (focus series) by action at 0 blurs scatter 2; the pointer over a large bar at 400 and off it at 800 -- the large path is no highDownDispatcher, so its mouseover / mouseout leave the blur alone; downplay at 1200
label.show false, emphasis.label.show true: the label is built and laid out, ignored at rest; hovering slice b at 0 shows it and its label line; out at 500
label.show false, select.label.show true, selectedMode single: select b at 0 (the label shows, moved with the slice), unselect at 500
label.show false, position inside, emphasis shows it: hover slice c at 0; out at 500
a funnel's label.show false: its default emphasis.label.show true shows the label and its line under the hover; hover band b at 0, out at 500
a funnel's inside label hidden at rest, shown under the hover of band d

a bar series whose emphasis hides its labels; bar 1 writes label.show of its own, which fillDataTextStyle copies to its emphasis.label.show (defaultEmphasis on the data item): hovering bar 1 at 0 keeps its label, hovering bar 0 at 800 hides bar 0's
repeated circles with margins: the glyph is hovered (emphasis, mouseover); the margin between two glyphs, inside the bar rect, hovers nothing (mouseout); the glyph again; out
symbolClip: the rect glyph is as long as symbolBoundingData and clipped at the value; a point on the glyph past the clip hovers nothing, one inside it hovers the bar
